reading.body:
The American Hospital Association's AI lobbying footprint is four filings, and nearly every lobbyist on them appears on all four.

That concentration is the pattern. Twenty-six of the thirty-six named lobbyists are listed on all four AI filings, and the remaining ten appear on three, two, or one. The filings name a single client, the association itself, under LDA client id 103572 and registrant id 2571. So this is one organization deploying a large, largely constant roster across a small number of AI disclosures, not a broad set of clients each with its own team.

For AI specifically, the useful signal is that hospital-sector lobbying on AI runs through an established trade association rather than individual providers. The data does not say which AI bills were named, what positions were argued, or whether the four filings are recent. It also does not connect this activity to data centers, power, or compute. A filing reports that a client lobbied on an issue, not the argument made, so the roster size shows organizational commitment to the topic and nothing about its direction.

summary: AMERICAN HOSPITAL ASSOCIATION filed 4 Lobbying Disclosure Act reports on AI held by this site. Its clients, the lobbyists named on those filings and the AI bills they name are below. LDA registrant id 2571.
